title.value: Distributional Bellman Operators over Mean Embeddings

abstract.value: We propose a novel algorithmic framework for distributional reinforcement learning, based on learning finite-dimensional mean embeddings  of return distributions. We derive several new algorithms for dynamic programming and temporal-difference learning based on this framework, provide asymptotic convergence theory, and examine the empirical performance of the algorithms on a suite of tabular tasks.   Further, we show that this approach can be straightforwardly combined with deep reinforcement learning, and obtain a new deep reinforcement learning agent that improves over baseline distributional approaches on the Arcade Learning Environment.
